requirement: EPIC-4 story 4.1 — Layered teaching model: teach a lesson one layer at a time (drums → bass) with completed layers still playing underneath, driven by lesson.teachOrder, with a layer-stack UI whose state is encoded by Anthropic-orange brightness.

architecture.decision: Teaching state lives in a small pure `src/teaching.ts` seam over (teachOrder, index); App owns `teaching: { index } | null` React state plus an active-layer ref read on the audio thread. Playback gates inside the SINGLE existing App.onStepAudio callback by the active-layer set — no new scheduler. Free-edit mode (teaching === null) keeps the current full-mix playback unchanged so editing still hears everything.
seams: src/teaching.ts pure API: activeLayers(teachOrder, index): string[] (completed + current = teachOrder.slice(0, index+1)); currentLayer(teachOrder, index): string | null; layerState(teachOrder, index, layer): 'locked' | 'active' | 'done'. Stories 4.2 (cue engine) and 4.3 (hit/miss) import currentLayer/activeLayers from here — do not inline this math in App.
Audio gating point = App's single onStepAudio callback, reading an active-layer ref. Never add a second scheduler or setInterval.

teachOrder source = the lesson (default ["drums","bass"]). The Pattern's kick/snare/hat lanes collectively ARE the 'drums' layer; the bass lane IS the 'bass' layer. Gating maps active-layer names to those lanes.

tasks.intent: Create the load-bearing pure module that computes teaching progression from (teachOrder, index). This is the seam 4.2 and 4.3 will import. No React, no audio, no DOM — pure functions plus a _selfcheck in the codebase convention.
tasks.constraints: Mirror the existing pure-module style (see src/pattern.ts, src/constants.ts): named exports, a _selfcheck() with console.assert, no side effects at module load. activeLayers = teachOrder.slice(0, index+1). currentLayer = teachOrder[index] ?? null. layerState returns 'done' for indices < current, 'active' for == current, 'locked' for > current. Do NOT touch App or any other file.

tasks.title: Wire teaching lifecycle: gate playback + layer-stack UI + grid lane state
tasks.intent: Turn the teaching seam into the observable feature: a user can start a lesson, hear only the active layers, advance layer-by-layer with the mix audibly thickening, and see a layer-stack UI whose brightness encodes state (done=dim, active=bright, locked=neutral). Exiting returns to full-mix free-edit.
tasks.constraints: Respect the seams: import activeLayers/currentLayer/layerState from src/teaching.ts (do not reinline). Gate audio ONLY inside the existing App.onStepAudio callback by reading an active-layer ref (useRef kept in sync) — no new scheduler, no setInterval, all timing stays on Tone.Transport. teaching state = `{ index: number } | null`; null means free-edit and MUST preserve today's full-mix playback (all lanes sound). teachOrder default ['drums','bass']. Brightness uses existing theme vars: --accent-dim (done), --accent-bright + --accent-glow (active), --text-dim/--edge (locked). a11y non-negotiables: layer state must not be color-alone — pair brightness with a text label (e.g. 'done'/'now'/'locked') and/or shape; controls are real <button>s, keyboard-focusable, ≥44px targets like existing .tbtn. 'Complete/Next' is user-driven (a button); at the last layer the button finishes/exits the lesson. Grid lane dimming for not-yet-active layers is a light visual reflection of the active layer — keep it minimal, honor prefers-reduced-motion (no new sweeping animation). Do NOT build the per-beat pad-echo/grid-cursor cue engine (that is story 4.2) or hit/miss (4.3).
tasks.acceptance: Starting a lesson gates playback to the first layer (drums only) and shows the stack with Drums active/bright, Bass locked. Advancing keeps drums playing (now dim) and cues bass (bright) — the mix audibly thickens. Exiting/finishing returns to full-mix free-edit playback. Build passes; no console errors; no setInterval added.
